What does carpet installation cost in Kenmore, WA?

Figure $4 to $7 per square foot installed in Kenmore, covering carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away. Most projects come in between $2,000 and $4,500, and a 1,200 sq ft main floor plus a staircase typically runs $5,500 to $8,500. Carpet grade swings the price most — and you choose it from samples laid out in your own house.
Does the mobile carpet showroom come to Kenmore?

It does — Kenmore is home turf, from Moorlands to Uplake. The van arrives with 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades, the samples go down in the rooms being carpeted so the color reads true in your light, then we measure everything and leave a written price the same visit. There's no store to drive to, and the appointment is free.
What does carpet stretching cost in Kenmore?

Carpet stretching in Kenmore starts at $99 per room. A power stretcher pulls out ripples, buckles and lifted edges for roughly a fifth of what replacement costs, so it's the smart fix whenever the pile still stands up and you still like the color.
How much is stair carpet in a Kenmore split-level?

Stair installation starts at $18 per step, in waterfall or cap-and-band style. Kenmore split-levels usually have two short flights instead of one long run — both flights, plus landings and winders, are counted in the written quote up front rather than billed later.
How long does a carpet install take?

One day for most Kenmore homes. A typical split-level — bedrooms up, rec room down, two half-flights between — is a normal day's work for the crew. A full house with heavy furniture can run into a second day, and the schedule is written on your quote.
Do the installers move my furniture?

Yes. Beds, dressers, couches and tables are included on most jobs, and everything goes back where it started. We just ask you to clear the small stuff ahead of time — closet floors, lamps, electronics, and anything fragile you'd rather carry yourself.
Should I restretch my carpet or replace it?

Restretch when the pile still stands, the backing is sound and the color still works — that's a $99-per-room fix instead of buying new. Replace when traffic lanes are crushed flat, seams are opening, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor has survived professional cleaning. We tell you which side yours falls on before we quote anything.
Which Kenmore neighborhoods does OC Flooring cover?

All of Kenmore — Moorlands, Arrowhead, Inglewood, Uplake, Lakepointe and the blocks off Bothell Way downtown — plus the neighbors: Lake Forest Park, Sheridan Beach, Finn Hill, Juanita, Brier, Bothell and Shoreline. Within about an hour of Kenmore, the van still comes.
What carpet holds up best with dogs and cats?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing, installed over a moisture-barrier pad. The barrier stops accidents from reaching the subfloor — which is where permanent odor comes from — and solution-dyed fiber keeps its color even through diluted-bleach cleaning. The barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot.
What warranty comes with the installation?

OC Flooring covers the workmanship with a 1-year warranty, and the carpet carries the mill's own warranty on top — usually 10 to 25 years on wear and stain, depending on grade. Both go in writing on your quote. The pad grade you pick can affect the mill warranty, which is why all three pad grades come along to the visit.
